sample_unit: cases (still images and video clips read by 6 endoscopists)

links.outcome: Standalone AI accuracy versus endoscopist accuracy with AI assistance
links.effect: Standalone AI accuracy for focal lesions was 91.31% (M1) and 92.51% (M2), but AI-assisted readers reached 86.84% overall (from 74.80%). Standalone performance overstated the human-AI team's performance.
links.quote: As a stand-alone model, AI achieved 91.31% (M1) and 92.51% (M2) accuracy for focal lesions (sensitivities 91.02% and 91.91%; specificities 95.50% and 96.12%).

screen.reason: The study conducts a reader study comparing endoscopists' diagnostic accuracy for gastric lesions with versus without AI assistance.

primary.practice: AI assistance vs unassisted reader interpretation
